meta.objective: Deliver an example feature through a sliceable task artifact.
out_of_bounds: Do not add a helper CLI
Do not store wave or index data in tasks.json

requirements_trace.description: The producer emits a structured detail artifact.
The consumer receives only the selected parent tasks.

where_this_fits: The artifact belongs under the selected feature root's specs/ directory.
technical_approach: Keep the compact execution index in execute.md and full task detail in this JSON file.
key_decisions: Use indented JSON so direct agent edits remain reviewable.

phases.title: Define Contract
phases.summary: Create the producer-side task detail contract.

parents.title: Example detail artifact
parents.description: Author the JSON task detail that downstream consumers slice by selected parent task ids.

subtasks.title: Write failing fixture parse check
subtasks.produces: A failing parse check that proves the fixture is absent or invalid

context.note: The producer skill owns the authoritative schema.

acceptance_criteria.text: File `plugins/spectre/skills/spectre-create_tasks/references/tasks.example.json` does not parse before implementation.
Parse command fails for the documented reason before the fixture is authored.

subtasks.title: Author parseable detail fixture
subtasks.replaces: The implicit Markdown-only task body contract

context.note: Current fields must have a JSON home.

acceptance_criteria.text: File `plugins/spectre/skills/spectre-create_tasks/references/tasks.example.json` exists and parses as JSON.
No stored `index`, `indexes`, `wave_plan`, or `waves` key appears in the JSON fixture.

phases.title: Consumer Slice
phases.summary: Show a consumer-owned parent-task slice with preserved task fields.

parents.title: Inline selected parent tasks into dispatch
parents.description: Extract the assigned parent tasks and pass only those task bodies to the owner.

subtasks.title: Dispatch a selected parent-task slice
subtasks.produces: An XML `<task_assignment>` envelope containing exactly parent task 2.1
subtasks.replaces: Whole legacy Markdown task-list reads by execution owners

context.note: The orchestrator owns selected parent-task extraction.

acceptance_criteria.text: The dispatch prompt contains parent task `"id": "2.1"` and no unrelated parent task id.
@spectre:dev receives the `<task_assignment>` envelope inline and is not instructed to read a tasks file.
